lines.text: A ladder leans over a big box to a wall.
lines.caption: A ladder leans over a big box to a wall.

lines.text: How long is it? Most kids stop halfway!
lines.caption: How long is it? Most kids stop halfway!

lines.text: The foot is nine feet from a box twelve tall, twelve deep.
lines.caption: The foot is nine feet from a box twelve tall, twelve deep.

lines.text: The ladder touches the box's top corner and reaches the wall. How long is it?
lines.caption: The ladder touches the box's top corner and reaches the wall. How long is it?

lines.text: The trick: nine across, twelve up is just three across, four up, repeated.
lines.caption: The trick: nine across, twelve up is just three across, four up, repeated.

lines.text: The wall is twenty-one feet away. That's seven of those steps.
lines.caption: The wall is twenty-one feet away. That's seven of those steps.

lines.text: So the ladder climbs seven fours, twenty-eight feet up the wall.
lines.caption: So the ladder climbs seven fours, twenty-eight feet up the wall.

lines.text: Twenty-one by twenty-eight is a three, four, five triangle, seven times bigger!
lines.caption: Twenty-one by twenty-eight is a three, four, five triangle, seven times bigger!

lines.text: So the ladder is seven times five. Thirty-five feet, Choice D!
lines.caption: So the ladder is seven times five. Thirty-five feet, Choice D!

lines.text: Why exactly that? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why exactly that? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
